prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Interactive Voice & Chat Switch Flow: Introduces an interactive desktop voice and text interaction setup module right on the home_intro screen to guide users through communicating with their companion.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Talk & Command Your Companion", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Press Alt+Space or talk aloud to command your companion.", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Creation Verification Screen: Inserts a dedicated pet design verification screen right after photo uploads to allow users to review and adjust parameters before rendering.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_verification", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_verification": {"headline": "Review Your Companion's Look", "body": "Verify lighting and features before finalizing your companion.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview", "style": "large"}]}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Late Account Sign-In Flow Reorder: Reorders sign_in to occur after adoption certificate customization, placing it right before the waiting screen to preserve pet creation data.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Compact Path Selector Layout Redesign: Replaces the existing path options layout on choose_path with a compact view that highlights core path differences clearly.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Choose Your Pet's Journey", "body": "Select whether you want to adopt a ready pet or craft a custom companion."}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Recovery Guidance Hint: Displays a supportive hint on the sign-in screen explaining how signing into an existing account restores previous pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Log into your existing account to restore previously adopted desktop pets seamlessly."}}
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Hide and Show Keybind Copy: Updates the headline and body on home_intro to emphasize the instant hide/show hotkey command.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Ready! Press Ctrl+Shift+H to Hide or Show Anytime", "body": "Your companion lives on your desktop. Use Ctrl+Shift+H whenever you want to toggle visibility or right-click for options."}}
6: [adoption, layout] Split View Adoption Certificate Layout: Changes the layout of adoption_certificate screen to 'split' layout for better visual clarity while naming your companion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Name Your New Desktop Companion"}}
7: [home, hint] Background Generation Completion Hint: Adds a clear hint to the waiting screen explaining that pet creation continues safely in the background even if minimized.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Your pet is being crafted. You can minimize this window; we will alert you when ready."}}
8: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Clarity and Format Copy: Replaces photo upload instructions with explicit resolution and file format guidelines.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Clear JPG or PNG Photos", "body": "For best results, upload well-lit photos facing forward. Avoid heavy filters or covered faces."}}
9: [choose_path, incentive] First Companion Decor Starter Incentive: Adds a starter decor badge component to the choose_path screen highlighting free desktop items included with setup.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Free Starter Desktop Decor", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a verification step inside onboarding is permitted.
Reordering sign_in step is explicitly permitted.
Redesign retains both path options for adopt and custom pet.
Valid guidance hint on sign-in screen.
Valid copy update on home_intro screen.
Layout update for adoption certificate is permitted.
Valid hint added to waiting screen.
Valid copy update for upload photos screen.
Onboarding copy mentions free extras, violating pricing rules.
